realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12di / WP-S2c-72 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as H-002 combined R1+R2 cycle 1 after the original full-period no-formal-split retrospective baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 4h history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-002 REP-0003 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

interpretation: REC-0040 derives from OL-0026 and is the WP-S2c-72 H-002 exp_success_criteria cycle 1 REC under approved combined R1+R2 methodology. It is exact-segment evidence only for H-002 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria, increasing that exact segment count from 1 to 2. It does not satisfy REC-5, does not floor-cross the segment, does not complete H-002, and does not complete A2C-002. Cost-drag is preserved but not deterministically compared because OL-0026.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0 makes cost_drag_fraction semantically uninterpretable as a pass/fail ratio. OL-0026 is reused by REC-0039 for the separate d2_006_gates exact segment under R1 paired-source reuse; separate REC artifacts and separate expectation-source comparisons preserve exact-segment separation. REC-0040 does not create H-002 completion, A2C-002 completion, Path B, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live/runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
notes: WP-12di creates REC-0040 from new committed OL-0026 against committed EXP-0003 success criteria. It moves H-002 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria from reconciliation_count = 1 to 2, still below REC-5 target 3. The same source OL supports REC-0039 for d2_006_gates under approved R1 paired-source reuse, with separate expectation-source comparison and exact-segment counting.
